lede: Kansas State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.6 against -2.6, a 4.1-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Kansas State -13.9 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Kansas State winning 82% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is defense, where Kansas State leads Tulane by 49 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 78% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
